one_line_contribution: A crossed design over who supplies the instruction slot (bare / hand-written spec / GEPA / MIPRO) against what is injected (real, content-substituted, order-shuffled, cross-query, skeleton, fixed, padding), claiming that retrieved agent memory helps only by supplying a syntax + procedural-schema scaffold that any instruction stating that scaffold already supplies, leaving memory with a net-negative content residual.
closest_prior_work: Two, and together they take most of the novelty. (1) GEPA (Agrawal et al., 2025) — cited here only as an optimizer, but its headline empirical claim is precisely that reflectively evolved natural-language instructions outperform few-shot demonstration search (MIPROv2 with bootstrapped demos), i.e. that the instruction slot substitutes for the demonstration slot. P2/P5 is that finding re-run with retrieved memory rather than bootstrapped demos in the demonstration slot; the proposal never engages with it as a novelty threat, which a reviewer will notice immediately since GEPA is the optimizer being used. (2) Boshi Wang et al., 'Towards Understanding Chain-of-Thought Prompting: An Empirical Study of What Matters' (ACL 2023), and Madaan & Yazdanbakhsh, 'Text and Patterns' (2022), which already decompose demonstrations into bridging objects (content) versus language templates/patterns (schema+syntax), already permute and corrupt reasoning steps, and already report that relevance and coherence-of-order carry a specific, separable share. E1/E7 is that decomposition transplanted from CoT demos to ReAct trajectories. The proposal's defence — that in agents a malformed output is episode-fatal rather than costing one token — is a real but incremental difference, and E2's parse-failure instrumentation is the only place it is cashed out. Min et al. (2022) is correctly named but is the weaker of the threats. What remains genuinely unclaimed is narrow: the specific crossing of memory against a *hand-written* scaffold specification (S_SPEC), and the S_GEPA-M co-adaptation arm.
strongest_objection: The primary claim is not identified by the design. Two problems compound. First, the gate: the track's own pilot reports that the injected bank fixed zero items and broke six to seven, so REAL−NONE at S0 — the denominator of every channel ratio in E1 and the left half of the P2 contrast — is expected to be at or below zero on this very setup. E0 is written to catch that, but its threshold (4 points) sits below its own minimum detectable effect at n=200 paired (~5 points at the stated 12% discordance), so the gate passes or fails largely by noise, and if it fails, P1, P2 and P3 — three of five confirmatory predictions — are unrunnable and the paper collapses to a re-statement of the pilot's already-known harm result. Second, even if the gate passes, P2 does not distinguish substitution from headroom. S_GEPA+NONE and S_SPEC+NONE are by construction the highest-accuracy memory-free cells; a fixed-size benefit added on top of a higher baseline shrinks in accuracy points under any monotone ceiling, with no scaffold-substitution mechanism whatever. The proposal half-notices this by fitting a mixed-effects logistic model, but then states P2's decision rule in raw points ('≥5 points at S0 to ≤2 points at S_GEPA'): the pre-registered test is on the log-odds scale and the pre-registered prediction is on the probability scale, and these can disagree in both directions, so the confirmatory rule is ambiguous before a single episode is run. Third, and separately fatal for the harm family: E3/P4 conditions on items correct under NONE and then compares break counts across conditions. That conditioning induces regression to the mean, and any condition with lower overall accuracy mechanically breaks more previously-correct items — so 'REAL and CROSS each break ≥2× SCRAMBLE-C at S_GEPA' is substantially entailed by the accuracy ordering the same experiment is trying to explain, not by content.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Add an accuracy-matched, scaffold-free instruction level — call it S_CONTENT: a hand-written instruction of the same length as S_SPEC that raises accuracy through task framing, hints or encouragement while stating nothing about output grammar, step budget, action ordering or stopping. If REAL's gain collapses at S_SPEC/S_GEPA but survives at an accuracy-matched S_CONTENT, substitution is about the scaffold; if it collapses at both, the whole result is headroom and the paper has no mechanism. Without this arm P2 is uninterpretable. (2) Pick one scale and one estimand for P2 before running: a logit-scale interaction as primary with a points-scale contrast declared secondary (or vice versa), not one as the test and the other as the threshold. (3) Add an oracle-memory arm and report the content channel relative to it. (4) Re-do the harm analysis as a paired model over all 700 items (e.g. condition × baseline-outcome interaction, or a paired comparison of REAL-vs-SCRAMBLE-C discordance directly, which is legitimate) instead of conditioning on the NONE-correct subset. (5) Pre-specify what SCRAMBLE-C's substituted observations do: entity-swapped observations are, by construction, factually false relative to the live Wikipedia index, so SCRAMBLE-C may be teaching observation fabrication rather than 'pure scaffold'; the 10% hand-screen checks fidelity of the rewrite, not whether the rewritten trajectory is now a hallucination demonstration. Add a fabrication-rate metric on the agent's own observations as a mechanism check. (6) Run the collision search — even manually, even reading only GEPA's and MIPRO's own instruction-versus-demonstration ablations — before submission.
missing_baseline: An oracle / upper-bound memory arm: inject the gold trajectory for the evaluated query itself (or the trajectory of a near-duplicate training query) at S0 and at S_GEPA. Every content-channel estimate in the plan (P3's ≤30% claim, the REAL−CROSS estimand, the whole 'memory earns its tokens only on idiosyncratic content' conclusion) is otherwise unidentifiable from simple retriever failure: bge-base top-4 over a 500-episode bank on HotpotQA distractor may just be retrieving nothing useful, in which case 'content contributes little' is a fact about this bank, not about content. A reviewer will demand the ceiling before accepting a null. Two further omissions worth naming: MIPRO is deliberately run in instruction-only mode with demonstration bootstrapping disabled, which removes the actual deployed competitor — full MIPRO with bootstrapped demos is the system whose demo slot memory is supposed to be replacing — and there is no accuracy-matched scaffold-free instruction level (see above).
preprint_collision: The check is not thin, it is empty: it reports that every search call failed, for the second consecutive revision, and the author states plainly that novelty is unverified. The honesty is creditable, and the retraction of the fabricated 'ExpRAG (arXiv:2603.18272)' identifier is exactly right and should be read in the proposal's favour on integrity. But under the standard that an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness, this is a substantial deduction, not a neutral: no closest-prior-work determination has been made, and the two threats I can name from background knowledge — GEPA's own instruction-versus-few-shot-demonstration result, and the CoT template-versus-bridging-object ablation line (Boshi Wang et al. ACL 2023; Madaan & Yazdanbakhsh 2022) — are both findable without any search tool at all, from papers the proposal already cites or uses. That they are absent from the Related Work's threat analysis suggests the gap is not only tooling. I cannot verify a specific 2025-2026 arXiv preprint that runs the crossed format/content decomposition on agent trajectories, and I will not invent one; but the 2025 agent-memory line (ReasoningBank and successors) is moving fast toward negative-transfer and memory-harm ablations, and the declared fallback — 're-position around E5/E7' — is weak, because E7 (step-order permutation) is the arm closest to Wang et al.'s existing perturbation study and E5's substitution framing is closest to GEPA's own thesis. The fallback ground may already be occupied.
